source_changes: Includes the route-trace leak fix and partitioned prefill selector. Full GLM additionally fuses FP8 indexer dots/head reduction into compact score keys for all query counts; single-query scores use FP64 accuracy checks. Flash and other families keep their existing paths; cache allocations and decode are unchanged. DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill now batches queries for the visible history within the unchanged CSA2 score workspace; all earlier DeepSeek-V4.1 measurements are replaced.

telemetry.scope: all serving ranks, from before startup through shutdown
telemetry.process_swap_policy: Each new serving process must be in a cgroup with memory.swap.max=0; both process VmSwap and cgroup memory.swap.current must stay zero. Missing protection or nonzero swap sends SIGINT and halts the campaign. OS swap stays enabled.
telemetry.clock_note: Host wall clocks differ; sample continuity uses each probe's monotonic clock.
